mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, reducing the cost of capital and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a supply-demand imbalance in the real economy, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between INDPRO and HOUST does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales index (RSAFS) indicates expanding consumer spending capacity, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS rises month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) combined with ultra-low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a weak labor market under accommodative policy, signaling economic fragility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE > 5.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) in late-cycle expansion signals labor market overheating, triggering wage pressures and Fed tightening expectations that drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.
